title: sys.health body v1
description: Heartbeat every service publishes on a fixed period (and immediately on state change). Also how jarvisd reports slow-consumer drops (invariant 5). Envelope conf = 1.0.

state.description: 'degraded' = alive but impaired (e.g. brain fell back to CPU, ears lost the mic).

period_s.description: Nominal heartbeat interval. Missing 2 consecutive periods = presumed dead.

drops.description: Frames dropped since the last heartbeat, keyed by topic. Published by jarvisd per slow subscriber; empty/absent = none.

metrics.description: Free-form numeric gauges (queue depths, RSS MB, VRAM MB, ...). Names are service-local; not part of the frozen contract.
